name: materialbox
title: Materialbox
description: Click an image to zoom it to fit the screen, with a dark overlay and an optional caption.
improvements: FLIP animation into a portal: no more forcing overflow: visible on every ancestor.
Keyboard accessible: the thumbnail is a button, Escape closes, focus returns to it.
alt is required and names both the button and the dialog.
Closes on a deliberate scroll or swipe instead of any scroll event; width/height pass through correctly.
